prompt: Lens at the height of the tabletop, 21mm, at the head of a long polished boardroom table in a 1920s bank. An elegant Mexican American gunman of about 35, lean clean-shaven face, sharp cheekbones, oiled black hair, cream double-breasted suit, sits three-quarter on in the chairman's seat, one hand resting a Thompson upright on his far thigh with the muzzle at the ceiling, well clear of his face. He sings politely. The table runs away behind him to a far doorway full of drifting gunsmoke; small bankers in black dive under it at the far end. Gold wall lamps warm his face; red light fills the smoke. Full frame, no bars. Thanks.
